case: existing 2-D Smagorinsky channel, nx=256, ny=128, Re_tau=100, 50000 steps, averaging after 25000

diagnostic_model_results_not_admissible.reason: the wall-resolved reference is underdeveloped, so model error cannot be separated from reference-flow error

assessment.next_required_reference: statistically stationary three-dimensional periodic channel with exact momentum-balance wall shear, followed by an adverse-gradient periodic-hill or equivalent case

conclusion: The existing two-dimensional channel accelerates throughout the run and misses its own wall-law profile, so it cannot validate or reject a pressure-gradient wall model. The run is retained as negative evidence against using an underdeveloped 2-D channel as a world-class reference.
